posts.title: My Favorite Records of 2025
posts.description: 2025 was the first year in quite some time where I released original music. It felt really nice to get that out into the universe so we can start working on new stuff. I’m incredibly proud of that album and if you haven’t checked it out yet I’d love for you to give it a spin at one of the links below (or wherever you listen to music.) Reach out to me through the following avenues: Mastodon: @karlgrz@mastodon.social Twitter: @karl_grz Email: karl [at] karlgrz [dot] com Github: karlgrz Outside of coding, I write and record some music, sometimes it ends up on SoundCloud.
